facts.fact: 清晨 Anya 来敲门送早餐与衣物；Cora 低声喊「妈妈，我想是 Anya 来了」，掀毯子像小鹿般跳下床——Anya 是王室派来侍候 Aurora 母女的侍女，Cora 是 Aurora 的女儿。
facts.anchor: “Mom, I think Anya is here,” Cora whispered and pulled the blanket off her, leaping out of bed like a deer.

facts.fact: Anya 站在门口问候：Aurora（"我"）当天上午已排定与学者们会面，她特意带早餐来让"我"出发前先吃。
facts.anchor: Anya stood in the doorway. “Good morning. I did not mean to wake you, but you are scheduled to meet with the scholars this morning, and I thought you might want some breakfast before leaving.”

facts.fact: Cora 把 Anya 拿来的蓝裙贴在身上转圈，告诉她「王子 Percie 和我是朋友」，猜今天可能再一起画画；Anya 打趣说殿下终于交到了朋友。
facts.anchor: Cora put it against her and twirled around. “Yes, please. Did you know that Prince Percie and I are friends? I think we may do some more art today.”

facts.fact: Anya 递给"我"一条松绿色（pine green）裙：通体绿、后背系绿色腰带，没有一丝粉色——告别前两日被硬塞的粉裙。
facts.anchor: I blinked. Green. A lovely pine green dress. Not a speck of pink to be seen. The dress was nothing fancy or embellished. Just a green dress with a green sash that tied in a bow at the back.

facts.fact: Anya 说明那两条粉裙都不是她挑的，并首次说出自己的 enchant：clairsentience（情绪共感）——不看脸也能感知他人的真实情绪。
facts.anchor: “Oh, no need to apologize. I picked neither of the pink dresses. Besides, I didn’t have to see your face to know how you felt. My enchant is clairsentience. I can feel someone’s true feelings and emotions.”

facts.fact: Anya 解释 atoner 制度：atoner 在正义之神 Themis 面前执行惩罚（鞭笞、羞辱性劳役、贵族削爵等）；国王 Torrish 与 Themis 直接沟通、传达该用的刑罚，全国只有国王一人有这条直通线。
facts.anchor: King Torrish speaks with Themis and tells the atoner what Themis sees fit to use as punishment for someone. Only the king has a direct line of communication with Themis.

facts.fact: "我"答 Edenalee 信仰：多神并存、各有祭坛神庙，全民共同供奉的只有命运女神 Clotha；"我"在药房工作还供医药女神 Airmed——Anya 说 Tironaill 禁止敬拜 Themis 以外的神。
facts.anchor: “Not exactly,” I said hesitantly. “We have many deities. Most have altars and temples, but the only one we all collectively pay tribute to is Clotha, the Goddess of Fate.

facts.fact: Anya 悄悄透露 Gabriel 的双 enchant：火系操控（fire-wielder，力量极强）＋次要的占卜（divination，为王室效力、需 scrying 工具与姓名地点等具体信息）——交换条件是"我"发誓不当面告诉他。
facts.anchor: “Gabriel is a fire-wielder. It isn’t a unique enchant, but his is extremely powerful,” she said with a shrug. “He also has a secondary enchant of divination, which is useful to the crown.

facts.fact: Anya 帮 Cora 穿衣时突然记起今早还欠女王 Mollah 一件差事、必须马上去办（怕她生气），丢下活计匆匆离开；临走说船长马上到、晚饭前再来打扮。
facts.anchor: “Yes. Sorry. I just remembered that I was supposed to do something for Queen Mollah this morning. I must leave and attend to it. I don’t want her upset with me.”
